$comment: Which recording a use-case node's run sends, from the node's `mediaOrder`, on BOTH engines and in the estimate: the server's (backend/src/services/workflow-engine/__tests__/use-case-media-order.test.ts: freshRunInputs and expandUseCaseNodes) and the editor's (frontend/src/__tests__/use-case-media-order.test.ts: the executor's request body and expandUseCaseNodes) are each held to the values here. Each case wires `wired` (upstream node ids, in edge-list order) into `media` of a node of `type` whose data holds `mediaOrder` (left out when absent) and expects the run to send `sent` (upstream node ids, in order) and the estimate to build on the first of them. Every type takes one recording in this phase. `mediaOrder` is read through usecaseMediaOrderOf: a list keeps its string ids, anything else orders nothing. Written by hand; a case is added, an existing expectation is changed only by a ruled decision.

cases.name: mediaOrder names the second wire: it is sent
mediaOrder as a string orders nothing: the first wire
mediaOrder with non-string entries keeps its string ids
mediaOrder naming no wired node: the first wire
one wire, mediaOrder naming another: that one wire
